{{Quote|What's the point of all this? I mean, why?''"<br />"''I don't know, sir. I don't think anybody knows. But what I ''do'' know is that someday, this war is gonna end.''"<br />"''Then what? We're soldiers. What happens to us then?|Clone Captain Rex and ARC trooper Fives|<ref name="Carnage of Krell">{{TCW|Carnage of Krell}}</ref>}}
'''Clone troopers''' were highly trained [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Representing the future of [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] warfare, [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] were designed to be far superior to [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. During the [[Great Peace of the Republic|last years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], clones formed the backbone of the [[Republic Military]] that waged war against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid armies]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] was named after the Republic's clone [[Army/Legends|army]], which became symbolic of the conflict that had spread throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] after a [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]] of peace.

Clone troopers were grown on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] at the request of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]], who commissioned the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] to build an army for the Republic, although some clones were secretly grown on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to supplement the army's numbers following heavy losses late in the war. After Sifo Dyas' [[Death/Legends|death]], the project was taken over by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Clones were modeled on a [[Human/Legends|human]] template, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], although their [[DNA/Legends|genetic structure]] was modified to make them less independent and more docile than their progenitor. They were also designed to age at twice the rate of [[Reproduction/Legends|natural]] humans, accelerating their growth and making them ready for combat in a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade's]] [[Time/Legends|time]]. As the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] gave way to open war, the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] empowered [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to call the clone troopers into action, leading to their debut on the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battlefield]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. For three [[Standard year/Legends|years]], clones fought the Separatist [[droid]]s on all fronts across the galaxy. They were loyal to their [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] and the Supreme Chancellor; though some clones questioned their service, leading to isolated cases of [[Cut Lawquane/Legends|desertion]] and [[Slick/Legends|treason]], most were proud to serve the Republic as it was the only life they had ever known.

[[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|Galactic history]] was forever changed by a [[Inhibitor chip/Legends|hidden behavioral modification biochip]] implanted in every clone, which was part of the Sith's plot to destroy the Jedi. Chancellor Palpatine, [[Showdown on Coruscant|discovered]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to be the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious, as well as the reason behind the Clone Wars, branded the Jedi as the [[Treason/Legends|enemies of the state]] and issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], with the latter being a calling for the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|annihilation]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. All across the galaxy, the clones turned against their Jedi officer[[General/Legends|s]], slaughtering them and [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|storming]] the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] under the [[501st Legion/Legends|stewardship]] of the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Sidious subsequently assumed [[Dictatorship/Legends|absolute power]] as the [[Declaration of a New Order|self-proclaimed]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Clones initially served as [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial stormtroopers]] in the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], but were soon replaced by human recruits and conscripts. Their [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]], [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|weapons]], and training inspired generations of [[Color/Legends|white]]-[[Armor/Legends|armored]] warriors.

==History==
===Commissioning and the genetic template===
{{Quote|They grow up loyal to the Republic&mdash;or they don't grow up at all.|[[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha]], quoting Jango Fett|<ref name="Republic50">[[Republic 50|''Republic'' 50]]</ref>}}
[[File:JangoRecruited-SWBH.jpg|thumb|left|Darth Tyranus would recruit Jango Fett as the progenitor of the clone army by contracting him to collect a bounty on his former padawan, Komari Vosa, who Jango defeated.]]
The origins of the clone troopers date back to the days<ref name="Darth P">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]], convinced that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] would soon face an existential threat, secretly commissioned [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] scientists to create an army for the Republic. The project was discovered by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Dooku/Legends|Tyranus]], a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master who turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] and became the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="AOTC" /> Tyranus betrayed and [[Death/Legends|murdered]] Sifo-Dyas at Sidious' behest, and the two Sith Lords took over the project for their own ends.<ref name="EG Warfare" />

Before the [[Clone Master/Legends|cloners]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] were able to begin their task, they required an individual subject to serve as the army's [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]]. Tyranus, who had been ordered by Sidious to both search for an ideal candidate amongst the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] deadliest [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and eliminate a deranged former Jedi named [[Komari Vosa]], devised a plan to accomplish the two objectives at the same time. Thus, he placed a five million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] reward on the capture of Vosa, who had become the leader of the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]]. Whether she was dead or alive after her capture was irrelevant as the prize was the same either way. Among the mercenaries who received a special invitation from Tyranus was [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], a former [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who sought to make a living as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].<ref name="BountyHunter">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>

[[File:Kamino_Facility.jpg|thumb|right|The cloning chambers in Tipoca City, primary cloning facility on Kamino]]
When Fett successfully tracked and [[Mission to Kohlma|defeated]] Komari Vosa in combat, Tyranus personally congratulated the hunter and, in addition to the reward money, offered a substantial amount of more credits if Fett agreed to be [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] on Kamino. The purpose, as Tyranus revealed, was the creation of an army of clones, modified to grow at twice the rate of [[Human/Legends|Human]] beings and programmed for absolute loyalty. Their training, supervised by Jango Fett, would turn them into perfect [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. After a moment of contemplation, Fett agreed to Tyranus' offer, but on the condition that the [[Boba Fett/Legends|first clone]] would be given to him without any modifications.<ref name="BountyHunter" />

[[File:Jango_Fett_and_Kal_Skirata.jpg|thumb|left|The training of the clone army was overseen by Jango Fett and a handful of bounty hunters he trusted known as the Cuy'Val Dar.]]
Before the gestation process began, the Kaminoans tampered with Fett's [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] to ensure that the clones were primarily dominated by behavioral genes that emphasized certain qualities such as loyalty, aggression, independence and discipline in order to guarantee that the army would be more docile and less independent than their template. [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]] [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]] personally oversaw the reconfiguration of the clones' mental capacities. Her delicate redesign ensured the clones would think independently, yet still remained preconditioned to obeying authority. Few scientists were capable of performing such a biological modification feat with a greater than ninety per cent success rate.<ref name=":0">{{FactFile|91|CLO 1-4|Clone Troopers}}</ref> Additionally, the Kaminoans increased their clones' [[Lung/Legends|lung]] capacity, decreased their reaction times and improved their stamina. Certain allergies and Fett's mild astigmatism were also removed from the genome.<ref name="Author's Cut 7">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-7-the-grand-army-of-the-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 7 &mdash; The Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref> [[Kal Skirata]], a former Mandalorian warrior who had been brought to Kamino to assist in the training of a special unit, concurred with the Kaminoans' rationale behind "modified" [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]; an "unaltered" Jango Fett was not the ideal infantry soldier.<ref name="TripleZero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>

Tyranus supplanted the Kaminoans with an inhibitor chip, which was to be instilled in the brain of each Clone. The chip was originally thought of by Sifo-Dyas, who intended for it to be a safeguard against rogue Jedi, but following his death, Tyranus and Sidious retooled the chip. Tyranus, who posed as a Jedi, presented the retooled chip to the Kaminoans and deceived them into believing Sifo-Dyas's intention. The true purpose of the retooled chip was to brainwash the Clones into murdering their Jedi superiors for being perceived traitors to the Republic, in order for the [[Grand Plan/Legends|Sith to reclaim control over the galaxy]].

[[File:Prudii.jpg|thumb|right|The first prototype clone troopers, Null-class ARC Troopers, were deemed failures by the Kaminoans, though they would be saved from termination by Cuy'Val Dar Sergeant Kal Skirata.]]
The Kaminoans also considered but rejected making the clone troopers sterile per their standard procedure for clone army projects. Senior research geneticist [[Hali Ke]] cited examples of sterile Human clones created for [[Tarshan Ring Excavations]] and infiltration squads created for the [[Lords of Purala IV]], where clone prototypes displayed much higher rates of mental instability, poor unit cohesion, an inability to adapt and think creatively, and decreased aggressiveness in battlefield simulations. The Kaminoans found separating this from "[[Factor H]]"&mdash;the Human variable they deemed so essential to creating effective, aggressive soldiers&mdash;impossible, and so eschewed sterile clones in the name of military effectiveness.<ref name="Author's Cut 7" />

When the Kaminoans first began the cloning procedure, they had produced twelve prototypes, designated [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null-class]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]], or ARCs. Due to the extreme modifications to their physiology, only half of the test subjects survived the gestation process. However, the "enhancements" that were made to the [[Clan Fett|Fett]] genome left the survivors handicapped with erratic behavior and an inclination toward disobedience. Disappointed<ref name="TripleZero" /> with the unsatisfactory results<ref name="CompleteEncyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> of their wayward creations, the Kaminoans deemed the six prototypes complete failures and intended to terminate them. Kal Skirata's intervention, along with Fett's support, prevented the clones from being liquidated. As a result, Skirata was charged with training the prototypes as intelligence units.<ref name="TripleZero" />

===Training===
{{Quote|They're trained from day one to be more obedient than us.|[[Atin Skirata|RC-3222]]|<ref name="HardContact">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Youngclonestraining.jpg|thumb|left|Created roughly five years before the Clone Wars, the younger clones physically resembled a ten year-old Jango Fett.]]
Due to the long-term commitment that was required in the creation of the clone army, Jango Fett took a hiatus from his bounty-hunting career to monitor the growth and training of his clones.<ref name="EncyclopediaJangoFett">{{SWE|characters|jangofett|Jango Fett}}</ref> His influence over the clone army's development extended into several areas, such as the resemblance between his [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] and their [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I armor]] and the training that molded the clones into elite soldiers.<ref name="AOTC" /> One of his most significant contributions to the project, however, was his personal oversight of the [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando|Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commandos]], otherwise known as "ARC troopers."<ref name="Republic50" /> The "second generation" ARC units were the Kaminoans' response to the failure of the Null-class. Unlike their precursors, the Alpha-class ARC troopers were more reliable for their loyalty to the Republic and willingness to serve under Jedi officers.<ref name="TripleZero" /> They were, however, superior and more creative in comparison to the rank-and-file clone troopers, due to their unaltered level of independence.<ref name="Republic50" />

Clones were decanted into birth cohorts of 32, and they trained, ate and slept alongside their batchers. These birth cohorts became the [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] clone troopers would fight in, having trained with their comrades literally from birth.<ref name="EG Warfare" /> Through the technological capability to accelerate the speed of a clone's physical growth, the Kaminoans successfully engineered fully grown clones in half of the time that real Humans required to reach maturity. As a result of the genetic modification that enhanced their growth process, the clone troopers aged at twice the rate of Human beings. At the chronological age of ten, a clone was resembling a young Jango Fett in his early twenties, and was thus fit and prepared for combat.<ref name="AOTC" />

Emotionally stable clones were required to ensure the army performed with the best results. The stress of accelerated physical, mental, and emotional development had adverse effects on a clone's mind. Having studied human psychology and how clones developed into mentally balanced adults, Taun We organized a comprehensive training and education program to shape the identifies of every clone during every phase of development. This was coupled with a carefully constructed learning environment that helped batches of clones maintain some semblance of community for added emotional stability. The training program emphasized military knowledge over academic knowledge. Young cadets were expected to fully assimilate this new information, but given their accelerated growth pattern, they only had half the normal time to digest it. To compensate for this problem, [[Clone trooper learning helmet|specialized helmets]] equipped with mental receptivity enhancers were worn to modulate a clone wearer's brainwaves to make the process of instruction retention easier.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1">[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]</ref>    

[[File:Clonestraining.jpg|thumb|right|At the age of ten, adult clones physically resembled Jango Fett in his early twenties.]]
All clone troopers received basic training in core military skills, such as weapons handling, marksmanship, drill, and other essentials.<ref name="AOTC" /><ref name="CloneCadets">{{TCW|Clone Cadets}}</ref> While Jango Fett personally handled the training of the Alpha-class ARC troopers,<ref name="TripleZero" /> a specialized unit of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] was commissioned as a median between the independent-minded ARC troopers and the more docile rank-and-file clone troopers.<ref name="HardContact" /> In order to ensure the overall success of the commandos project, Fett formed the ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]''- a group composed of experienced Mandalorian mercenaries and even a few [[Journeyman Protector/Legends|Journeyman Protectors]]. Though individual members of the group had their own unique training methods, as a whole, they separated the commandos into [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of four, which in turn created a strong sense of brotherhood amongst the commando squads.<ref name="TripleZero" /> Clones that were fit to serve in leadership capacity possessed notable traits, such as a greater degree of independence and creativity, as exhibited by [[Clone Commander/Legends|commanders]] like [[Cody/Legends|Cody]],<ref name="EncyclopediaCody">{{SWE|characters|clonecommandercody|Clone Commander Cody}}</ref> and [[Deviss/Legends|Deviss]].<ref name="GrandArmyGuide">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref>

As part of their education and psychological training, the clone troopers were required to adhere to the [[Command Code]], a set of guidelines that governed a clone's behavior and every action.<ref name="CestusDeception">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref> Hence, every clone was obliged to obey every aspect of the Code without question, doubt or hesitance.<ref name="SWHiddenEnemy">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Hidden Enemy]]''</ref> Overall, the Kaminoans took a deeply vested interest in the training of the creations, especially the standard clone units<ref name="AOTC" /> and even the clone commandos, as well.<ref name="RepublicCommando">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref>

===Mandalorian Heritage===
{{Quote|They'll do their job well. I'll guarantee that.|[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
[[File:RexPhase2Leap-SWE.png|thumb|left|Clone Captain Rex was an independent thinker and skilled soldier, like his template, Jango Fett.]]
Through Jango Fett's connection to the clone troopers as their genetic template, as well as the presence of many Mandalorian trainers within the ''Cuy'val Dar'', many societal aspects of Mandalorian culture were integrated into the mentality of many clones. The clone commandos were particularly susceptible to this outside influence since they experienced the most exposure to Mandalorians. Likewise, the Null-class ARC troopers were raised as Mandalorians by Kal Skirata. The use of [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']]&mdash;the native language of the Mandalorians&mdash;began amongst the commandos and was gradually adopted by clone troopers of the rank-and-file stock.<ref name="TripleZero" /> One particular feature of the Mandalorian culture that the clone army assimilated was the "[[Jaig eyes]]," a mark of honor bestowed on soldiers for exceptional acts of bravery.<ref name="TMPaC">{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref> ARC Captain [[Fordo]] was commended with the Jaig eyes,<ref name="CW23">{{CW|23}}</ref> as was [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]<ref name="TCWf">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>, who was to be an officer of the famed [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].

[[File:Spar.jpg|thumb|right|ARC Trooper Spar would fully embrace his Mandalorian heritage, fleeing Kamino and forming the Mandalorian Protectors, a mercenary group which would fight for the Separatists against the clone army.]]
Although Mandalorian influence was especially strong on the clone commandos,<ref name="TripleZero" /> the mainstream of the clone army held loyalty and obedience to the Galactic Republic as the overriding priority above all other concerns or interests.<ref name="AOTC" /><ref name="TrueColors">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref> The connection between the clone army and its Mandalorian heritage was greatly strained when [[Spar]], a renegade Alpha-class ARC trooper, deserted the Republic and organized the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] on the side of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. The heavy casualties that the clone troopers endured due to the involvement of Spar and his Mandalorians at [[Battle of New Bornalex|New Bornalex]] and [[Battle of Kamino (Separatist–Mandalorian invasion)|Kamino]]<ref name="MandalorianHistory">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref> caused the clones to develop a strong sense of enmity toward the Mandalorians, whom they now regarded as enemies of the Republic. The troopers of the [[2nd Airborne Company/Legends|2nd Airborne Company]] were openly hostile with [[Omega Squad]] because of the commandos' Mandalorian "upbringing."<ref name="TrueColors" />

The end of the Mandalorian culture's influence over the clone army commenced with the production of new generations of clone troopers, grown and trained away from Kamino and under direct Republic supervision. The first wave of clones that eventually supplanted the original troopers were engineered through [[Spaarti cloning cylinder|Spaarti technology]], which was most notable for the fact that it developed fully matured clones in one year (as opposed to the longer Kaminoan method of ten years).<ref name="Order66Novel">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> The decline of Mandalorian influence was further accelerated when the Galactic Empire's [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] became dominated by enlisted troopers and clones based on different genomes, which thus reduced the remaining Fett clones to a minority status.<ref name="BattlefrontII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

===Aberrations===
[[File:99-SWE.png|thumb|left|99 was a genetically imperfect clone trooper deemed unfit for combat, though due to the Jedi's intervention, 99 would not be terminated and instead be transferred to janitorial work on Kamino.]]
Despite the Kaminoans' dedication to perfection when it came to their work, the cloning process produced a minority of clones with genetic abnormalities. [[Eye/Legends|Eye]] color proved particularly prone to variation, while many clones would have subtly different facial features to their fellow batchers. In some 3.5 percent of clones in each batch, however, genetic variations were so extreme that reconditioning was required, a euphemism that could include anything from genetic therapy to termination.<ref name="EG Warfare" /> One instance included a [[Company/Legends|company]] of clones that possessed less than 20/20 vision. They mysteriously disappeared in the late hours of the night and were never seen again.<ref name="TripleZero" />

The Kaminoans were immensely proud of their low margins of aberrance. To maintain and improve these numbers, they corrected, studied, and removed deviant specimens. Chief Scientist Ko Sai carefully inspected the clones during each stage of development to determine if any had drifted from the disciplined training program.<ref>{{FactFile|101|CLO 5-6|Clone Troopers}}</ref> [[Observation Ship/Legends|Observation ships]], [[KE-8 Enforcer Ship/Legends|KE-8 Enforcers]],<ref>[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)'']]</ref> and [[Brainwave probe|brainwave probes]]<ref name=":1" /> were used to identify aberrant clones. Clones that deviated from the behavioral norm or were too independent had their minds corrected with brainwave cancellers from [[Reorientation unit|reorientation units]],<ref name=":1" />or they were isolated and reconditioned. The reconditioning program destroyed the will, hope, and sometimes even the life of clones. Those who survived were a psychological mess. The Kaminoans wielded fear to keep the clones in line. Disobedient clones who talked back to their clone masters were made examples of by disappearing to reconditioning, never to be seen again. This forced the other abnormally independent clones to maintain unremarkable facades and act as unindividual as they possibly could to avoid reconditioning.<ref name="Order66Novel" />       

Terminations were largely halted after the Jedi took a more active role overseeing clone trooper training during the Clone Wars, with aberrant clones largely being shunted into support roles.<ref name="EG Warfare" /> One genetically aberrant failure, [[99/Legends|99]], was relegated to janitorial responsibilities, since he was physically incapable of military service.<ref name="CloneCadets" /> These procedures would still occasionally miss aberrants, such as the "[[Mad Clone of Kaikielius]]," who avoided being noticed during his growth and training only to go berserk during the [[Kaikielius campaign]] of the Clone Wars and murder his batchers in the belief that he was in a training simulation where his comrades had been replaced by disguised droids.<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-9-battlfields-of-the-clone-wars|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 9: Battlefields of the Clone Wars}}</ref>

===The Clone Wars begin===
{{Quote|An army of one man, but the right man for the job!|Clone trooper rallying call|<ref name="Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Republic_Assault.png|thumb|right|Republic clone troopers were first deployed to Geonosis in 22 BBY.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="EG Warfare" /> ten years after the start of the clone trooper program, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] tracked Jango Fett to the remote world of Kamino in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Much to his surprise, however, his arrival in Tipoca City was greeted with great anticipation from the Kaminoan cloners. [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]] assumed that Kenobi had been sent by the Jedi Order to obtain a progress report on the Republic's clone army, and thus, he never realized that Kenobi was oblivious to the existence of the clones. Nevertheless, Kenobi inspected the clones for himself and learned from Lama Su that 200,000 units were prepared for deployment; another million were nearly combat-ready as well. When Kenobi attempted to apprehend Jango Fett, the bounty hunter escaped to the Separatist world of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. Kenobi pursued Fett, only to be captured and held hostage by [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku, the former Jedi Master who secretly became the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Tyranus.<ref name="AOTC" />

[[File:Yoda_and_his_squad.png|thumb|left|Under the command of Grand Master Yoda, clone troopers would rescue several Jedi from execution in the Petranaki Arena.]]
While the Jedi [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of Naboo, conducted their own attempt to rescue Kenobi, the Galactic Republic fell into a crisis as the Separatist movement evolved into an armed rebellion. As a response to the revelation of the Separatists' intentions to secede through force, the Galactic Senate granted [[Emergency Powers Act/Legends|emergency powers]] to the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|executive branch]] of the government. With his new authority, Chancellor Palpatine accepted Kamino's clone army on behalf of the Senate, and thus, the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] was officially formed. Shortly afterward, Jedi Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] assembled a Jedi task force to liberate Kenobi; [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] traveled to Kamino to inspect the clone army for himself.<ref name="AOTC" />

[[File:CommandoCleanUpOnGeo.jpg|thumb|right|Thousands of clone troopers would perish in their first deployment of the Clone Wars, some due to the Jedi's inexperienced leadership.]]
By the time Yoda and a force of 192,000<ref name="ITW:AOTC">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> clone troopers arrived on Geonosis, the Jedi had been locked in a battle with the Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], but were ultimately overwhelmed, suffering heavy casualties. The clones successfully extracted the survivors, including Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala, as the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|first battle]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] commenced. Under the leadership of the Jedi, the clone troopers quickly forced the droid army into full retreat. Although Count Dooku and the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] avoided capture, Geonosis ultimately fell to the Jedi and their clone forces; the Republic had secured the first victory of the war.<ref name="AOTC" />

====Across the stars====
{{Quote|There is something very touching about them. They look like soldiers; they fight like soldiers; and sometimes they even talk like soldiers. They have all the finest qualities of the fighting man. But behind that is nothing—no love, no family, no happy memory that comes from having truly lived. When I see one of these men killed, I weep more for him than for any ordinary soldier who has lived a full and normal life.|Jedi General Ki-Adi-Mundi, on the clone army|<ref name="Hard Contact">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Handooine.jpg|thumb|left|Clone troopers in formation with several Republic walkers prior to engaging in the Battle of Jabiim.]]
Although the Jedi and some Senators were concerned about the untested soldiers and wary of their sudden appearance, most Republic [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalists]] welcomed this strong defense and applauded Palpatine's decision to use the clone troopers.<ref>[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide|''Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide'']]</ref>

The victory on Geonosis was followed by the deployment of clone troopers throughout the known galaxy, where they served on various fronts against the growing Separatist Alliance. The members of the Jedi Order were commissioned as officers in the Grand Army of the Republic. Under the leadership of their Jedi [[Jedi Commander/Legends|commanders]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|generals]], the clones engaged the Separatists on numerous battlefields, from [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]], [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Teth]]<ref name="TCWf" /> and [[Battle of Ryloth (disambiguation)|Ryloth]],<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref> to [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|Hypori]],<ref name="CW20">{{CW|20}}</ref> [[Battle of Jabiim|Jabiim]],<ref name="Republic55">[[Republic 55|''Republic'' 55]]</ref> and [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] itself.<ref name="ARC Troopers">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref>

Despite the overall combat effectiveness of the clone troopers, their numbers steadily decreased throughout the war by attrition, an increasing rate of casualties, and their own accelerated aging process, Due to the clones maturation process, clone life expectancy was considerably short; many clones exhibited characteristics of far older men such as grey hair, receding hairlines, baldness and wrinkles. By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], roughly three years after the first engagement at Geonosis, only two-thirds of the first generation clone troopers were still alive.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

====A face and a name====
{{Quote|There's not much to look at here, sir. We all share the same face.''"<br />"''Deceive you, eyes can. In the Force, very different each one of you are.|Yoda and Thire on [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]]|<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref>}}
[[File:Cody-ssnap.jpg|thumb|right|Clone Commander Cody]]
Though often viewed as the "flesh and blood" equivalent of battle droids, clone troopers possessed a capacity for individuality.<ref name="NewBattlefronts">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> They were bred for no other purpose than combat, but nevertheless they developed as individuals under the guidance of their Jedi officers.<ref name="EncyclopediaCloneTroopers">{{SWE|groups|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> The Jedi's [[Force power/Legends|unique abilities]] and leadership prowess earned them the admiration and respect of the clones who served under them. [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Bly]], second-in-command of the 327th Star Corps, felt that the Jedi were in command because they were the best in the Grand Army of the Republic.<ref name="Republic68">[[Republic 68|''Republic'' 68]]</ref> Moreover most Jedi, such as Yoda,<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref> [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence">{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref>, [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]<ref name="What Goes Up...">{{CWACite|5|What Goes Up... (comic story)}}</ref>, and Obi-Wan Kenobi considered the clones to as worthy of respect and life as any other beings, and went to great lengths to not waste the lives of their men.<ref name="TCWf" /> General [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] expressed upset that the clones were brought up without the love experienced by normal men and greatly wept whenever a clone under his command was killed.<ref name="Hard Contact" />

Clone troopers were officially identified by sets of letters and numbers. Every soldier's wrist was scannable and contained an [[Identifying code/Legends|identifying code]], which displayed information such as designation, rank and battles fought.<ref name="MIA">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref> Less than a year after the Clone Wars began, many clones adopted nicknames to complement their official designations with the approval of the Jedi.<ref name="TCWf" /> Captain Rex speculated that efficiency was the reason clones had been permitted to have "names," due to the difficulty of distinguishing genetically identical soldiers at an individual level.<ref name="The Deserter">{{TCW|The Deserter}}</ref> Another way that the Jedi fostered individuality in the clone troopers was through example; some clones respected their Jedi officers enough to emulate their leadership styles. Captain Rex developed a sense of impulsiveness during his service under Anakin Skywalker. Marshal Commander Cody had a strict adherence to procedure, a trait that was appreciated by Obi-Wan Kenobi.<ref name="EncyclopediaCody" /> The camaraderie that gradually developed between Jedi and clones was mirrored through others as well, including Aayla Secura and Bly,<ref name="Republic68" /> or Plo Koon and the clones of [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]].<ref name="Rising Malevolence">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref> Even though clones like [[Thire/Legends|Thire]]<ref name="Ambush" /> and [[Sinker/Legends|Sinker]]<ref name="Rising Malevolence" /> saw nothing unique about an army composed of clones from one genetic template, Grand Master Yoda sensed that each clone trooper felt different through the Force.<ref name="Ambush" />

[[File:Sykedeath.png|thumb|left|Ghost was one of a handful of clone troopers that managed to break from his programming and betray the Republic, joining the Separatists.]]
Despite the great lengths that the Kaminoans took to ensure that all clone troopers were unconditionally loyal to the Galactic Republic, there was evidence of flaws within their work. Ordinary, standard-issue clone troopers were programmed to be absolutely subservient, but a few of them developed too much as individuals to the point where said loyalty was overridden. Examples included [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Slick/Legends|Slick]],<ref name="The Hidden Enemy">{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy}}</ref> [[Ghost (clone trooper)|Ghost]] and [[Cut Lawquane/Legends|Cut Lawquane]].<ref name="The Deserter" /> Tempted by thoughts of freedom and wealth, "Slick" became a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the Separatists while feigning loyalty to the Republic. He excused his treachery through his belief that the clones were [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]], even though his actions caused the deaths of many of his "brothers" on Christophsis, much to the disgust of Cody and Rex.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> Ghost, too, betrayed both the Republic and his fellow clones, selling his service to the Confederacy of Independent Systems in exchange for a way out of the war. Cut Lawquane began his life on Kamino like every other clone trooper, but later became a deserter after he abandoned his comrades during the First Battle of Geonosis.<ref name="The Deserter" />

[[File:Cloneboys.jpg|thumb|right|Clone troopers, comrades and soldiers of the Republic]]
Smaller signs of individuality were seen in how some clone troopers broke away from the regulation haircut. Even before the mass production of [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II armor]], many clones had been allowed to customize their Phase I armor in various ways, either with color or additional equipment.<ref name="TCWf" /> Aside from armor customization, another indication of individualism was the clone troopers' affinity for Kamino, which they regarded as their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="EncyclopediaCloneTroopers" /> When Kamino was twice threatened by Separatist invasion, both Cody and Rex expressed concern for the safety of "their" planet.<ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref><ref name="ARC Troopers" /> In their second attempt, the Separatists reached Kamino and assaulted Tipoca City itself. Many clone troopers ultimately perished while defending the laboratories and military complexes that they viewed as "home."<ref name="ARC Troopers" />

[[File:Kota.jpg|thumb|left|Believing the clone troopers were unfit for battle, Jedi Master Rahm Kota relied on his own militia of enlisted soldiers and Separatist prisoners of war.]]
In spite of the mutual respect between clones and Jedi, not everyone felt the same optimism about the clone troopers. [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]], a well-respected and highly skilled Jedi General, was not so easily fooled by the clones' seemingly innocent nature. Regarded as a military genius on the battlefield, Kota concluded that clone troopers made inadequate soldiers. "Real" Humans were unhindered by the modifications that Kota felt limited the clones, and thus he concluded they were ultimately more intelligent, intuitive and versatile than the clones. Hence, Kota formed his [[Kota's Militia|own militia]] and refused to have anything to do with clones.<ref name="TFUdb">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> Ironically, his distrust of clone troopers was vindicated when they betrayed and murdered their Jedi officers just before they went on to enslave the galaxy under the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref><ref name="BattlefrontII" />

Aside from Kota, Jedi Master [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] personally disliked the clone troopers, especially single-minded ones like Commander [[Faie/Legends|Faie]].<ref name="SWHiddenEnemy" /> Some [[Republic officer/Legends|officers]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], especially those who joined the [[Commission for the Protection of the Republic/Legends|Commission for the Protection of the Republic]], held clone troopers in a low regard as well.<ref name="Order66Novel" />

[[File:Faie-Luminara-Quinlan.png|thumb|right|Quinlan Vos was one of a handful of Jedi who held reservations against trusting their clone troopers, often clashing with his Clone Commander, Faie.]]
In addition, there were some alleged concerns within the legislature for the use of clones in war. This ultimately resulted in a law being passed via Senate decree late in the Clone Wars that confined military cloning to a few Republic facilities, as well as banning military-related cloning for all except closely regulated medical exemptions. The law also explicitly banned the purchase of sentient clones, sale of cloning equipment, or the employment of cloning specialists. However, the true purpose of these laws was to place a monopoly on the cloning enterprise.<ref name="Author's Cut 7" />

====Palpatine's secret army====
{{Quote|You worry too much, Clonemaster. I only require your clones to be fit for purpose, and that means they have no need to meet the exacting standards as the army bred on Kamino. The Grand Army has to be the very best in the galaxy for one single special operation ahead of them. This is the culmination of my strategy&mdash;two armies with two quite separate tasks.|Chancellor Palpatine, to the Spaarti lead clonemaster supervising the production of a new clone army on Centax-2|<ref name="Order66Novel" />}}
[[File:Coruscant_system-TPM.jpg|thumb|left|Palpatine's secret operations to quickly produce additional clone troopers were established on Centax-2, one of the moons orbiting Coruscant.]]
After three years of constant warfare, the ranks of the Grand Army began to wear thin as the rate of battlefield attrition continued to increase and out-pace the ability of the Republic to breed and train replacement clones. Further, the remaining clone troopers were stretched thin throughout the galaxy during the Republic's [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Campaign]]. In response, Chancellor Palpatine who was secretly the Sith Lord Darth Sidious, secretly commissioned a new cloning operation, away from Kamino and under his direct supervision. Unknown to all except a select few, millions of clones were being engineered on [[Centax-2/Legends|Centax-2]], one of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] moons.<ref name="Order66Novel" />

Developed in secret, the new clone army was distinguished from the original clone troopers by two main factors: the use of Spaarti technology by [[Arkanian Microtechnologies]] scientists. After relations soured between Chancellor Palpatine and Kamino Prime Minister Lama Su, [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] Clone Masters were contracted to develop additional clones in secret facilities on Centax-2. The use of Spaarti cloning cylinders enabled them to produce full-grown troopers in only one year, as opposed to the ten years needed for clones bred on Kamino.<ref name="Order66Novel" />

[[File:Mygeeto.jpg|thumb|right|The 501st Legion would be supplemented by Spaarti clone troopers, increasing their numbers.]]
Given the short time required for the gestation process and the resulting accelerated growth to adulthood, the "Spaarti" clones required a rushed training regime. Through a [[Flash pumping|flash-pumping]] program,<ref name="Author's Cut 7" /> the clones were effectively "programmed" to be disciplined soldiers. However, the speed of their growth, compounded by their limited form of education, produced troopers with significantly decreased skills in key areas such as strategic thinking and marksmanship. Also, unlike the clone troopers from Kamino, the "Spaarti" clones showed very little individuality and were completely free of Mandalorian influence.<ref name="Order66Novel" />

The secret project ultimately produced millions of clone troopers, along with the necessary hardware of thousands of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and weapons. This new army was scheduled for deployment in 19 BBY on a date roughly correlating with the third anniversary of the First Battle of Geonosis. However, before their scheduled debut, a limited number of "Spaarti" clones were field-tested through units such as the [[14th Infantry Brigade]], while others were assimilated into the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] and the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard's]] [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]].<ref name="Order66Novel" />

When Count Dooku and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] led a Separatist surprise attack on Coruscant, which was orchestrated by Sidious, the Spaarti-bred clone army was unveiled for the first time. The introduction of several million new clones and thousands of new starships caught the Separatists by surprise, and proved essential to the Republic's eventual victory in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. Another essential part of the battle was Sidious as Palpatine, betraying Dooku by having him killed by Anakin. In the immediate aftermath of the battle, the additional ships and men swelled the ranks of the depleted Grand Army as the Clone Wars quickly neared its end.<ref name="Order66Novel" />

[[File:442nd-coruscant.png|thumb|left|With the Battle of Coruscant, millions of Spaarti clone troopers were deployed to defend the Republic capital, with few aware of their origins.]]
Despite the obvious lower quality of the Spaarti clones in comparison to their Kaminoan-engineered brethren, to the extent that their Kaminoan counterparts described them as poor soldiers with only a rudimentary knowledge of battlefield tactics,<ref name="Author's Cut 7" /> Chancellor Palpatine was not bothered in the least. During a conversation with a Clone Master from Arkanian Microtechnologies, Palpatine admitted that the new clones did not have to be of the same caliber as their precursors. He merely required the Spaarti clones to be the best soldiers for one specific operation- the true purpose behind their creation.<ref name="Order66Novel" />

====Order 66====
{{Quote|Execute Order 66.''"<br />"''It will be done, my Lord.|Darth Sidious and Jaigalaar during the execution of Order 66|<ref name="ROTS" />}}
[[File:501st-ROTS.png|thumb|right|Sergeant Fox and the 501st Legion during Operation: Knightfall]]
On the eve of the end of the Clone Wars, the Jedi Council discovered the identity of Darth Sidious; the illusive Sith Lord responsible for the war was actually Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, leader of the Galactic Senate of the Republic. As a result, the Council chose to act swiftly in an attempt to neutralize Sidious as soon as possible. On behalf of the Senate, the Jedi Masters Mace Windu, [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]] and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] marched into the [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Chancellor's Suite]] in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] and, with lightsabers drawn, declared Chancellor Palpatine to be under arrest. Despite their efforts, however, the [[Showdown on Coruscant|showdown between the Jedi and Sith]] ended with the deaths of all four Jedi Masters, as well as Anakin Skywalker's betrayal and fall to the dark side of the Force.<ref name="ROTS" />

Promoted to the position of apprentice to the Dark Lord of the Sith, the newly anointed Darth Vader marched into the Jedi Temple at the head of the 501st Legion; their mission was to kill every living being inside without exception. At the same time, Sidious issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to the various clone commanders that were dispersed throughout the galaxy as deputies to Jedi generals and commanders. As one of [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|150 contingency orders for the Grand Army of the Republic]], Order 66 labeled every Jedi as a traitor to the Republic. As a consequence, their clone soldiers were authorized to suppress the "Jedi insurrection" with deadly force.<ref name="ROTS" />

[[File:Bacara_Mygeeto_66.png|thumb|left|Commander Bacara and the Galactic Marines executed Order 66 without hesitation or remorse.]]
Upon Sidious issuing the order, the clones' inhibitor chips activated and forced them to view the Jedi as traitors to the Republic and subsequently eliminating them, without question. Though clones such as Cody<ref name="EncyclopediaCody" /> and Bly<ref name="Republic68" /> had come to respect their Jedi leaders after three years of warfare, their inhibitor chips forcibly eclipsed their loyalty to the Jedi.<ref name="ROTS" /><ref name="EncyclopediaCody" /> For the most part, the Jedi failed to anticipate the betrayal of the clone troopers. Without a moment of hesitation, Cody ordered a nearby [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] to fire on Obi-Wan Kenobi, though the Jedi Master ultimately survived the clones' treachery. Other Jedi, however, were not as fortunate.<ref name="ROTS" />

[[File:BlyShootsAayla.png|thumb|right|Aayla Secura was summarily executed by her clone troopers in accordance with Order 66.]]
The unsuspecting [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] was ruthlessly gunned down by Commander [[Bacara/Legends|Bacara]] and the [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marines]] while in the midst of the [[Battle of Mygeeto|Battle of]] [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]]; Aayla Secura was shot, repeatedly and fatally, on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] by several clone troopers, including Bly, the clone commander whom she enjoyed a close-working relationship with; Plo Koon, the Jedi Master who developed a deep affinity for the clone troopers, was murdered by Captain [[Jai'galaar (clone)|Jaigalaar]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]; [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]] was betrayed and killed on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] by Commander [[Neyo/Legends|Neyo]] and [[CT-3423]]; Commander [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] tried to shoot Yoda in the back during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], but was instantly beheaded with ease by the Grand Master. Despite this, all throughout the galaxy, the clone troopers complied with Order 66, and the Jedi that faithfully served the Republic in its time of need, at the risk of their own lives, were systematically slaughtered by the very soldiers they had come to trust and rely on.<ref name="ROTS" />

On Coruscant, no one inside the Jedi Temple was spared. Although a few survived the initial result of Order 66, such as [[Kazdan Paratus]], Shaak Ti,<ref name="TFUdb" /> and [[Sha Koon]],<ref name="STD">''[[Purge – Seconds to Die]]''</ref> nearly every Jedi that was caught in the Temple was killed by Vader and the clone troopers of the 501st. Masters, Knights, Padawans and even [[Youngling/Legends|Younglings]] were murdered by their former comrade and the remorseless clones. When the [[Coruscant Prime/Legends|sun]] rose on [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]] was a success; the massacre of the Jedi Temple was complete.<ref name="ROTS" />

===Dawn of the Galactic Empire===
{{Quote|The clone troopers, now proudly wearing the name of Imperial stormtroopers, have tackled the dangerous work of fighting our enemies on the front lines. Many have died in their devotion to the Empire. Imperial citizens would do well to remember their example.|Emperor Palpatine, during the Declaration of a New Order|<ref name="Republic HNN">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref>}}
[[File:MassacreofNewPlympto.jpg|thumb|left|Clone troopers, now stormtroopers, would enforce the new Galactic Empire's authority with extreme prejudice, crushing several resistance groups and Separatist holdouts.]]
Even as the clone troopers carried out Order 66, Darth Sidious called for an emergency session of the Senate, which he addressed in his public guise as Chancellor Palpatine. In what became known as the [[Declaration of a New Order]], Palpatine gave his own account on the details of the event that preceded Order 66, naturally fictionalized in order to garner the overwhelming support of the Senate and the citizens of the Republic. In a prolonged speech regarding the downfall of the Jedi Order and the end of the Clone Wars, Palpatine announced that the Republic would be supplanted by a New Order; the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|first Galactic Empire]], in which he would rule supreme as its first [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|emperor]].<ref name="ROTS" /><ref name="EncyclopediaSidious">{{SWE|characters|darthsidious|Darth Sidious}}</ref><ref name="EncyclopediaPalpatine">{{SWE|characters|palpatine|Palpatine}}</ref><ref name="EncyclopediaEmpire">{{SWE|groups|empire|Galactic Empire}}</ref>

[[File:DVandtheLostCommand.jpg|thumb|right|Darth Vader leading clone stormtroopers during the Atoan insurgency.]]
Just as the Republic was renamed and reorganized into the Empire, the clone troopers were also affected by Palpatine's reforms. No longer known as the clone troopers who defended the Galactic Republic under the leadership of the Jedi Order, the clones were anointed as [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial stormtroopers]]. Without the guidance of their Jedi officers, the stormtroopers quickly became one of the most visible symbols of the new authoritarian regime, emphasized by the brutal manner in which they enforced the will of Emperor Palpatine.<ref name="ROTS" /><ref name="EncyclopediaCloneTroopers" /><ref name="EncyclopediaStormtroopers">{{SWE|groups|stormtroopers|Stormtroopers}}</ref> In recognition of their loyalty and service to the Empire, the 501st Legion was placed under the direct command of Darth Vader. Under his direction, the 501st built a reputation of fear and brutality as "Vader's Fist."<ref name="BattlefrontII" />

Despite the stormtroopers' betrayal of the Jedi Order and their new purpose as oppressors, the clones adjusted well to their Imperial duties;<ref name="DT4">[[Dark Times 4|''Dark Times'' 4]]</ref><ref name="BattlefrontII" /> Clone Commander [[Appo/Legends|Appo]] was particularly pleased with the continued use of clones as military assets, especially due to his previous assumption that the clones would have been diminished as "glorified policemen" after the Clone Wars came to an end.<ref name="DT4" /> Over time as the Empire gradually asserted its dominance over the galaxy, Jango Fett's cloned progeny secretly enjoyed opportunities to destroy local insurrections, mainly because of their desire to maintain an efficient military while keeping the Empire feared by its own citizens.<ref name="BattlefrontII" /> The [[1st Platoon]], however, became a mercenary unit,<ref name="Mask of the Pirate Queen">''[[Mask of the Pirate Queen]]''</ref> while a clone acting as a [[rogue assassin]] was active as a killer for hire.<ref name="BF II PSP">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PlayStation Portable|PSP]] version}}</ref>

===End of the Fett cloning program===
{{Quote|Since the Empire has redirected the clone trooper program to other pursuits and stepped up recruiting inferior humans from the Outer Rim, the operational effectiveness of this army has declined significantly.|Commander Cody|<ref name="TFUIIDatabank" />}}
[[File:Anti-trooper_BF2.png|thumb|left|An Anti-Imperial clone trooper, created to liberate Kamino from the Galactic Empire]]
When the Clone Wars came to an end, the Galactic Empire secured the vital cloning facilities of Kamino in order to ensure the continued production of [[Clone stormtrooper|cloned stormtroopers]].<ref name="KaminoTFUII">{{SWE|locations|kamino|Kamino}} ('''Video Games''' section, '''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II''')</ref> However, the Kaminoans resented the [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] occupation of their homeworld, which was ironically conducted by their own creations. As a result, a covert rebellion was formed as several clone masters plotted to liberate Kamino from Imperial control.<ref name="BattlefrontII" /> But even before the Republic's reorganization into the Empire, Prime Minister Lama Su reserved a portion of the clone troopers from the overall army that the Kaminoans engineered for the Republic. He later reflected on this decision near the end of the Clone Wars as relations between Coruscant and Kamino became strained.<ref name="Order66Novel" />

The preserved DNA samples of the Fett template provided the Kaminoan rebels with the means to forge a new army of clone troopers based on Jango Fett's genetic structure. Unlike their previous creations, however, the new generation of clones would be programmed with absolute loyalty to Kamino. After roughly a [[12 BBY/Legends|decade]] of operating in secret, the rebel clone army grew to full adulthood through the technology of accelerated growth. The majority was trained as [[anti-trooper]]s; clone soldiers trained as [[Clone jet trooper/Legends|jet troopers]], armed with the [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]] and the [[DC-15x sniper rifle/Legends|DC-15x sniper rifle]], and equipped with Phase I armor. A [[Rail-class Advanced Recon Commando|new breed]] of Advanced Recon Commandos was created as a smaller, more elite force to complement the anti-troopers. These ARC troopers possessed the [[ARC trooper armor/Legends|same armor]] as their predecessors and were armed with [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|Z-6 rotary blaster cannons]].<ref name="BattlefrontII" />

At the same time, however, the Galactic Empire discovered the clandestine project and immediately reacted with force. The elite stormtroopers of the 501st Legion were dispatched to Kamino with orders to fully subjugate their own homeworld. Boba Fett, a bounty hunter and clone of Jango Fett, was hired by the Empire to serve as the 501st's mission commander, mainly because of his knowledge of Kamino's cloning facilities. In order to defeat the [[Kaminoan resistance]] with a decisive victory, however, the 501st Legion was commanded to annihilate their entire brethren of rebel clones.<ref name="BattlefrontII" />

[[File:Kaminouprising.jpg|thumb|right|An anti-trooper and a stormtrooper fighting inside Tipoca City]]

Upon their arrival at Kamino, Boba Fett and the stormtroopers of the 501st Legion stormed Tipoca City in a direct assault on the planet's primary cloning facility. Despite the fierce resistance of the anti-troopers, the Imperials breached the facility's outer defenses and retrieved a sample of Jango Fett's DNA. Meanwhile, the fighting intensified on Tipoca City's platforms as Fett clones from both sides killed each other. As the Imperials steadily took more ground on the platforms, a new objective directed their efforts toward the destruction of the incomplete rebel clones. Though initially deterred by a force of ARC troopers, the Imperials infiltrated the cloning labs, destroyed the clone tanks' life support systems and killed their "brothers" who were still in the process of development. Without reserve stocks to provide additional troopers to the rebel army, the clones attempted to evacuate their Kaminoan masters on two [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]]. Both vessels were ultimately destroyed, and with the deaths of the last remaining rebel clone troopers, the Kaminoan resistance collapsed as the Empire claimed victory over Kamino.<ref name="BattlefrontII" />

[[File:ImperialMilitary-BF.jpg|thumb|left|The Clone Rebellion compelled the Empire to begin diversifying the ranks of the Imperial Army, rather than relying solely on Fett clones.]]
The incident of the [[Kamino uprising|Clone Rebellion on Kamino]] was regarded by the Galactic Empire as highly confidential; the information was classified and kept out of the public's knowledge. Though the 501st Legion proved its unwavering loyalty once again, even to the extent of killing their fellow Fett clones, Emperor Palpatine decided to reconsider his reliance on an entire army cloned from just one source. The creation of the anti-troopers had demonstrated the inherent danger in over-dependence on a single template of clone soldiers; the corruption that they were easily susceptible to was too great of a risk to the Empire's security. Hence, new stormtroopers were cloned from a variety of additional genetic templates. The 501st Legion was allowed to maintain "Fett purity" within its own ranks, but the rest of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] became increasingly diverse through different clones and enlisted troopers. None of the Fett clones, especially the ones who served in the 501st, were able to reconcile themselves to the fact that they had been marginalized into a minority within the army that they once filled as a whole.<ref name="BattlefrontII" />

[[File:Stormswarm.jpg|thumb|right|While the Imperial Army became more diverse, the stormtroopers of the 501st Legion remained exclusively comprised of Jango Fett clones and would go on to partcipate in several major battles against the growing rebellion.]]
The diversity continued to spread throughout the ranks over the next [[1 BBY/Legends|decade]] as more [[Gender/Legends|male]] Humans were recruited from the Outer Rim Territories and trained as stormtroopers. By this time, the few remaining Fett clones that survived the Clone Wars still carried a strong sense of hatred for all troopers who did not originate from Jango Fett's template. Their animosity extended particularly toward enlisted troopers. Commander Cody, the clone who originally served under Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi, became bitter and nostalgic due to the significant decline in the military's operational effectiveness ever since the Empire increased the rate of recruitment for the stormtrooper ranks. Cody had an extremely low opinion of enlisted troopers and regarded them as "idiots" that lacked any sense of themselves or their surroundings. As a veteran of the Clone Wars who once hailed from the Grand Army of the Republic, Cody despaired over the quality of the Stormtrooper Corps, which he saw as an embarrassment to the legacy of a once truly remarkable military force.<ref name="TFUIIDatabank">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] Databank entry</ref>

[[File:Darktrooper_Death_Star_Uprising.jpg|thumb|left|Phase Zero Darktroopers were cybernetically augmented clone troopers, attempting to combat their accelerated aging to prolong their Imperial service.]]
As the clones serving under the Empire grew older, their bodies began to degenerate at an increased rate. [[Imperial Institute of Military Medicine|Imperial researchers]] discovered that years of exposure to battlefield contaminants and sustained stress had created mutations that accelerated their aging by more than twice the normal rate.<ref name="TrueColors" /> By the time the clones reached the equivalent of their forties, many presented biomarkers that displayed they were in their fifties and sixties. This rapid degradation of the clone's tissue forced the Empire to retire most of their oldest remaining clones to the [[CF VetCenter|VetCenter]] on Coruscant<ref name="RepublicCommando" /><ref name="HardContact" /> and the [[Troopers' Rest|Trooper's Rest]] on [[Sochi]].<ref>{{StoryCite|story=Soldiers of the Empire!|book=Star Wars Official Poster Monthly 4}}</ref> As clone Stormtroopers began to lose their combat effectiveness, the Empire cycled them out of frontline units and reassigned them to garrison posts in less volatile regions. The most experienced and capable of these aging clones were sent to training centers to train the next generation of Stormtroopers. Few of these clones were capable of embracing their new desk jobs training their sub-par replacements and suffered with suicidal thoughts. The Empire attempted to curb the loss of their most experienced soldiers by transforming aging clones into cyborgs under the [[Phase Zero dark trooper|Phase Zero Dark Trooper]] program, but this endeavor was ultimately deemed a failure after the clone subjects proved too mentally unstable after their transformations to continue living.<ref name="The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

[[File:TH-313_Tacker_CotG.png|thumb|right|TH-313, a Captain within the Stormtrooper Corps]]

===Legacy===
Even though Fett-based clones had largely been shelved, with cloning even being considered a clandestine science after the rise of the Empire, military-related cloning and research had not ceased. Various top-secret facilities conducted research on creating Force-sensitive prime clones,<ref name="Author's Cut 7" /> similar to the clones [[X1]] and [[X2]] from the Clone Wars.<ref name="Elite Squadron">''[[Star War Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref> In addition, [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] ended up making the discovery that using [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamiri]] to sever a developing clone's connection to the Force resulted in the creation of mentally stable clones to be created in mere weeks, a discovery he later intended to use to his advantage during his actions against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Author's Cut 7" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Take care of the equipment, Eight-Three.''"<br />"''And the equipment will take care of us, Seven-Four.|[[Seven-Four]] and [[Eight-Three]]|<ref name="Equipment (short story)">{{StoryCite|story=Equipment (short story)|book=Star Wars: Short Story Collection}}</ref>}}
===Armor===
[[File:PhaseICloneTrooper1-Fathead.png|thumb|left|The first clone troopers were equipped with Phase I armor.]]
During the development of the first generation of clones, [[Kaminoan Armorsmiths Ltd./Legends|Kaminoan armorsmiths]]<ref name="NEG">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> forged Phase I battle armor; the military combat uniform of the clone troopers. The armor was loosely based on the design of Jango Fett's Mandalorian [[Mandalorian shock trooper|shock trooper]] armor. The most notable feature of Mandalorian influence in the armor's design was the helmet's distinctive T-shaped visor. The full uniform consisted of twenty<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]]<ref name="CompleteEncyclopedia" /> armor plates, attached to a black body glove. Other aspects of the armor included the helmet's breath filter, a [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] and the boots' high-traction soles.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />

At the beginning of the Clone Wars,<ref name="AOTC" /> Phase I battle armor used color to distinguish clone officers from each other and the rest of the rank-and-file stock. For instance, commanders were marked by [[Color/Legends|yellow]] stripes; captains, [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] and sergeants were identified by red, blue and olive green respectively.<ref name="NEG" /> However, this system of military uniformity was relaxed early in the war, and color was used in some cases to indicate unit affiliation instead of rank. Though many clone troopers maintained their armor in traditional white other clones&mdash;particularly officers&mdash;customized their uniforms through color and design.<ref name="TCWf" /> In recognition of their achievements, some clones were allowed to add specific designs to their armor, such as a Mandalorian award known as "Jaig eyes."<ref name="TMPaC" /><ref name="CW23" /><ref name="TCWf" />

The clone troopers who received specified training for various roles other than infantry were equipped with variant forms of Phase I battle armor. [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|Clone pilots]] wore the same armor as regular troopers, but were distinguished by yellow markings and specialized full-face helmets.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> [[Flame trooper/Legends|Clone flame troopers]] were protected from the potential dangers and setbacks of their own role by insulated body gloves and suits chilled by coolant reservoirs.<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> Clones assigned to noncombative assignments, such as [[Clone medical officer/Legends|medical officers]]<ref name="SWCWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|naval officers]], wore military dress uniforms, similar to the design of attire of Human officers in the Republic Navy.<ref name="TCWf" />

[[File:Clone_Troopers_Phase_II.jpg|thumb|right|Clone troopers in various forms of Phase II battle armor]]

The principal drawback of the Phase I battle armor, however, was its heavy and uncomfortable design. Hence, it was disparagingly referred to as the "body bucket." As a result of such imperfections, the flaws of Phase I were eliminated through the conception of Phase II battle armor.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />

As the Clone Wars, progressed, Phase I was ultimately rendered obsolete when the clone troopers switched to its Phase II successor. The new armor was designed to be superior to its predecessor in every aspect; stronger, lighter and more adaptable. This advanced armor also possessed many specialist variations,<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> suited to clones such as [[Clone scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]], [[Clone paratrooper/Legends|paratroopers]] and [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RT]] [[AT-RT driver|drivers]].<ref name="ROTS" /> But due to the rigors of war, Phase II battle armor was more battle-dented and mud-smeared than the Phase I precursor.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> The practice of color design and armor customization was carried over to the new armor as well. By the time of the Battle of Coruscant in 19 BBY, various clone divisions were visually distinguished from each other primarily through different color designs.<ref name="ROTS" />

===Weapons and kit===
[[File:CloneTrooperTypes-TCWCG.png|thumb|left|Clone troopers in specialized armors]]
The nonspecialized clone trooper's primary weapons for ranged combat were the DC-15A blaster rifle and its more compact counterpart, the [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] blaster carbine.<ref name="AOTC" /> In addition, clone troopers often carried one or more grenades of varying types, such as the [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[V-1 thermal detonator]], [[LXR-6 concussion grenade/Legends|LXR-6]] [[Concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenades]], [[V-6 haywire grenade]]s,<ref name="Battlefront">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]''</ref> and [[Electromagnetic pulse grenade/Legends|"droid popper" electromagnetic pulse grenades]].<ref name="RepublicCommando" />

The pouches and compartments of a trooper's highly functional utility belt contained a multitude of equipment, including a grappling hook, spare ammunition, ration supplies and a rudimentary [[Medpac/Legends|medical kit]] containing enough [[Synthflesh/Legends|synthflesh]] and [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] to keep a wounded soldier alive until a [[Medic/Legends|medic]] could arrive. While neither was part of their official-issue kit, most clone troopers also carried [[Multi-tool/Legends|multitools]] and a pack of sanitary wipes.<ref name="EG Warfare" /> Clone troopers were outfitted at Grand Army [[Barracks|troop centers]].<ref name="GB:CC">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref>

==Specialized clone troopers==
In addition to the standard infantry troopers that composed the bulk of the clone army, a select number of clones were trained for specialized roles, such as piloting<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> and command.<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> As the Clone Wars progressed, more clone trooper variants were deployed, from jet troopers<ref name="Battlefront" /> and flame troopers<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> to Advanced Recon Commandos<ref name="ARC Troopers" /> and [[Covert Ops clone trooper]]s.<ref name="TrueColors" /> In addition, regular clone troopers could carry heavier weaponry and armor and carry the designation of Heavy clone trooper and [[Repeating blaster/Legends|Repeater]] clone troopers.<ref name="GB:CC" />

===Combat role-specialized variants===
[[File:ARCcmdrColt-TCW.png|thumb|right|ARC Commander [[Colt/Legends|Colt]] in Phase II armor]]
*[[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force troopers]] carried out reconnaissance and surveillance for [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]].<ref name="TCWf" />
*[[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]] performed special reconnaissance missions. Regular clone troopers could be promoted to the rank of ARC trooper.<ref name="ARC Troopers" />
**[[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando]]s represented the GAR's most elite and deadly soldiers.<ref name="Republic50" />
**[[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]]s, though deemed failed experiments, were activated as the GAR's lead [[Clone Intelligence/Legends|clone Intelligence]] units.<ref name="TripleZero" />
*[[Blurrg trooper]]s were troopers who rode [[Blurrg/Legends|blurrgs]] and carried [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]] for anti-armor roles.<ref name="GB:CC" />
*[[Clone assassin]]s were engineered with fast reflexes, trained in stealth, and armed with [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]].<ref name="ROTSvg">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' video game]]</ref>
*[[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commandos]] trained, lived, and worked together in four-unit [[Squad/Legends|squads]] to perform covert operations that were too complex for ordinary troopers. They were regarded as superior to standard clone troopers, though not quite the equals of ARC troopers. They were trained by mandalorian sergeants, hand picked by Jango Fett, called Cuy'Val Dar.<ref name="RepublicCommando" /><ref name="HardContact" />
*[[Clone blaze trooper]]s were equipped with heavily armed and armored battle suits, designed for heavy engagements.<ref name="ROTSvg" />
*[[Clone marine]]s were specifically trained to repel [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] boarding parties, as well as to board and sabotage enemy [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]].<ref name="BattlefrontII" />
*[[Covert Ops clone trooper]]s were trained for stealth missions, including assignments that marked clone deserters for summary execution.<ref name="TrueColors" />
*[[Clone ordnance specialist/Legends|Clone ordnance specialists]] were troopers trained for the disarmament and disposal of explosive weapons.<ref name="TCWVirus">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref>
*[[Clone scout trooper/Legends|Clone scout troopers]] performed reconnaissance and scout missions.<ref name="ROTS" />
*[[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone trooper commanders]] combined enhanced tactical knowledge with advanced combat skills.<ref name="AOTC" />
*[[MEC trooper]], a heavily armed class of clone trooper variants.<ref name="RenegadeSquadron">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''</ref>
*[[Clone shadow trooper/Legends|Clone shadow troopers]] were an elite group of stealth units trained for covert operations that pertained to [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] jurisdiction.<ref name="rs.com">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (toy line)|pack=Utapau Shadow Trooper (Super Articulation!)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/rots05shadowtrooper.asp}}</ref>
*[[Clone shock trooper/Legends|Clone shock troopers]] of the elite [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] under [[Homeworld Security Command]] were tasked with enforcing law and order on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TCWf" /><ref name="ROTS" />
**Included [[Riot clone trooper/Legends|riot clone troopers]], who received additional training in riot control.<ref name="SWCWCE" />
*[[Clone medic/Legends|Clone trooper medics]] were trained to diagnose and treat wounded soldiers in the field.<ref name="The Deserter" />

===Environment-specialized variants===
*[[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|Clone cold assault troopers]] were trained specifically for battle and survival in extremely cold regions.<ref name="TCW:CS">''[[The Clone Wars: Cold Snap]]''</ref>
*[[Clone SCUBA trooper/Legends|Clone SCUBA troopers]] were adapted for aquatic warfare.<ref name="WW">{{TCW|Water War}}</ref><ref name="Prisoners">{{TCW|Prisoners}}</ref>

===Equipment-specialized variants===
[[File:OddBall.jpg|thumb|right|A clone pilot]]
*[[Clone heavy assault trooper|Anti-air clone trooper]] carried [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]] for use against aerial targets.<ref name="GB:CC" />
*[[AT-RT driver]]s piloted [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transport]] walkers.<ref name="ROTS" />
*[[AT-TE commander]]s led the massive [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] walkers.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />
*[[Biker Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|BARC troopers]] were expert [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeder]] riders.<ref name="ROTS" />
*[[Clone blaze trooper]]s and [[clone trooper grenadier]] provided heavy, close range anti-troop firepower.<ref name="ROTSvg" />
*[[Clone engineer]]s were a special group of troopers trained in vehicle maintenance and demolition work.<ref name="BattlefrontII" />
*[[Clone heavy assault trooper|Clone heavy troopers]] were heavy weapons specialists, equipped with specialized armor, and armed with missile and rocket launchers.<ref name="BattlefrontII" />
*[[Clone jet trooper/Legends|Clone jet trooper]] were equipped with [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] and trained for aerial combat.<ref name="BattlefrontII" />
*[[Clone lancer trooper]]s operated speeder bikes and jousted with [[power lance]]s.<ref name="CW8">{{CW|8}}</ref>
*[[Clone paratrooper/Legends|Clone paratroopers]] were an elite group of clones specially made for high-altitude combat jumps, and thus they were equipped with specialized helmets and armor.<ref name="ROTS" />
*[[Clone sharpshooter/Legends|Clone snipers]] were specialized troopers whose primary objective was to kill enemies from a distance.<ref name="BattlefrontII" />
*[[Heavy weapons clone trooper/Legends|Clone heavy gunners]] were troopers that specialized in heavier anti-troop weapons.<ref name="ROTSvg" />
*[[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|Clone trooper pilots]] were trained to fly a wide range of vehicles, from the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] to the [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="ROTS" /> They also served as field technicians.<ref name="Battlefront" />
*[[Flame trooper/Legends|Clone flame troopers]] were specialized in using [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]] and other incendiary weapons.<ref name="NewBattlefronts" />
*[[Clone trooper grenadier]]s carried [[Mortar/Legends|mortars]].<ref name="GB:CC" />
*[[Clone medic/Legends|Clone trooper medics]] carried equipment to diagnose and treat fellow clones in the field.<ref name="The Deserter" />
*[[Special ops clone trooper/Legends|Special ops clone troopers]] were called in for dangerous and difficult missions.

===Other variants===
====Rebel Clones====
*[[Anti-trooper]]s were designed specifically for the [[Kaminoan resistance|rebellion]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. They were programmed with absolute loyalty to their [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Clone Master/Legends|Clone Masters]] and trained as [[Clone jet trooper/Legends|jet troopers]].<ref name="BattlefrontII" />
*[[Rail-class Advanced Recon Commando|''Rail''-class Advanced Recon Commandos]] were the latest known generation of ARC troopers, equipped with [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I]] [[ARC trooper armor/Legends|ARC armor]] and armed with [[Chaingun/Legends|chainguns]]. They were created to complement the anti-troopers of the Kaminoan resistance movement.<ref name="BattlefrontII" />

==Rank notation==
