At the start of the Clone Wars, rank of the troopers was determined by color worn on their helmet, arm and shoulder armor.<ref name="AOTC" /> In time, however, some clone officers were allowed to design and customize their armor. Notable examples included Commander [[Fox/Legends|Fox]] and Captain Rex.<ref name="TCWf" />

[[File:Clone_Troopers_Phase_I.jpg|thumb|right|Early in the war, specific color denoted rank.]]
*White&mdash;[[Private/Legends|Private]] (standard trooper).<ref name="GrandArmyGuide" /><ref name="AOTC" />
*Olive green&mdash;[[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]]; commanded [[Squad/Legends|squads]] made up of nine troops.<ref name="GrandArmyGuide" /><ref name="AOTC" />
*Blue&mdash;[[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]]; commanded [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] composed of four squads (36 troops).<ref name="GrandArmyGuide" /><ref name="AOTC" />
*Red&mdash;[[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]]; commanded [[Company/Legends|companies]] made up of four platoons (144 troops).<ref name="GrandArmyGuide" /><ref name="AOTC" />
*Yellow&mdash;[[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]]; commanded [[Regiment/Legends|regiments]] made up of four battalions (2,304 troops).<ref name="GrandArmyGuide" /><ref name="AOTC" /> Many of these commanders were grown with more capacity for independent thought than the rank-and-file clones,<ref name="BattlefrontII" /> and were sometimes known by nicknames rather than numbers.<ref name="ROTS" /> They also received training from the [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando|ARC trooper]] [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha-17]].<ref name="GrandArmyGuide" /> Notable clone commanders included [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], [[Bly/Legends|Bly]], [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]], [[Bacara/Legends|Bacara]], [[Appo/Legends|Appo]], [[Neyo/Legends|Neyo]], and [[Thire/Legends|Thire]].<ref name="ROTS" />

With the development and distribution of Phase II battle armor, clone troopers ceased using color markings to denote rank. Instead, color patterns on troop armor signified legion designation and position.<ref name="ROTS" /> Troopers with Phase II armor, such as Commander Cody, also wore colored stripes along their arms indicating the campaigns they served in.<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>

==Designations==
[[File:Captain_Ordo.jpg|thumb|<!-- For those of you about to change this to Delta Squad...AGAIN....This is an Omega Squad commando. For more information, read the discussion at Talk:Clone_trooper/Archive1#NOT_DELTA_SQUAD.21.21.21 --> A Republic Commando (left) and ARC trooper [[Ordo Skirata|Null-11]] (right)]]

Clone trooper commanders received the designation CC-(number)<ref name="GrandArmyGuide" /> or CRC (for [[clone regimental commander]]).<ref name="TCWCampaignGuide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Null-class Advanced Recon Commando were designated N- or Null-.<ref name="TripleZero" /> Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando were identified with an A- or Alpha- designation,<ref name="Republic50" /> and clone commandos the RC- (for Republic Commando) designation.<ref name="RepublicCommando" /> Clone trooper captains and Clone trooper lieutenants were designated CC- or CL-, respectively.<ref name="TCWf" /><ref name="AOTC" /> The CT- designation was for Clone trooper sergeants and rank-and-file clone troopers.<ref name="GrandArmyGuide" />

==Behind the scenes==
All of the clone troopers were digitally created in both [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']]. Their voices were provided by [[Temuera Morrison]], who also provided the faces for Commander Cody, [[Davijaan/Legends|Odd Ball]], and Captain Jai'galaar, wearing a blue bodysuit that would be replaced in post production by the character's clone trooper armor. Morrison also provided the voice of clones in many games, principally ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'' (while the regular clones were voiced by [[Roger Jackson]]) and the [[Star Wars: Battlefront|''Battlefront'']] series. Younger clones were portrayed by [[Daniel Logan]] (in ''Attack of the Clones'') and [[Bodie Taylor]] (in both ''Clones'' and ''Sith''). In the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars|''Clone Wars'' cartoon]], the voice of the clone troopers was provided by [[André Sogliuzzo]]. In the [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Revenge of the Sith'' game]], [[Andrew Chaikin]] voiced the clone troopers, and [[Dee Bradley Baker]] voiced the clone troopers in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.

Before the release of ''Attack of the Clones'', the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel series [[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy]] stated that the clones of the Clone Wars were on the side against the Republic. Furthermore, promotional material for ''Attack of the Clones'' portrayed the clone troopers as the background for Dooku, Jango Fett, et al.

In ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'', the player may enter LEGION as a cheat code to unlock the playable clone trooper skin.

The design of the clone trooper armor is similar to the armor used by the [[Republic trooper]]s, the predecessors of the clone troopers in the pre-Clone Wars era. This implies that some of the clone trooper's armor could have been based on that design, once the Galactic Republic became affiliated with Kamino.
